title: Answer
description:
A voice is still speaking. Today puts a later people under that same voice, the same generation’s provocation, and the same rest.

The provocation was a testing of the Speaker, not a small complaint about thirst.

What was refused was not only a land or a report. It was God, who had sworn to give what He promised.

He was angry for forty years. That generation died short of His rest. Unbelief here is not ignorance of a promise. It is refusal of a promise already heard. Hearing without faith does not enter.
